scripts.build: npm run build -w kalibra-sdk && npm run build -w @kalibra/web && npm run build -w kalibra && npm run build -w @kalibra/desktop
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/server && tsc -p packages/cli && tsc -p packages/web && tsc -p packages/demo && tsc -p packages/desktop && tsc -p packages/sdk
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start -w @kalibra/desktop
